The Opportunity
 Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (Real-Time CDP) helps organizations unify customer data — and our team takes it further, building the engine that lets organizations securely collaborate on data at enterprise scale.
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll own features end-to-end — from the distributed backend services that move and process data, to the interfaces that make that complexity usable for our customers. If you're driven by complexity, ownership, and end-to-end impact — this is your challenge.
 What You'll Do
Own features end-to-end — from UI to API to backend service — with a strong sense of ownership over quality, scalability, and performance
Contribute to architecture and system design decisions that span the full stack
Improve system reliability, observability, and performance across layers
Mentor teammates and foster a collaborative environment
Work across teams and domains, including cross-geo collaboration
This list reflects the breadth of the role, not a checklist. We're looking for the right fit and growth potential, not a perfect match on every line. 
 What You Will Need To Succeed
 Fullstack Engineering Foundation
8+ years building complex, data-driven web applications and backend services
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and the React ecosystem
Experience designing and building backend services in Java or Node.js
Experience with GraphQL and/or REST APIs — both consuming and designing them
Working knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases
 Distributed Systems & Quality
Experience designing and operating distributed services and microservices
Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar)
Hands-on experience with E2E and unit testing (Playwright/Cypress, Jest, or equivalent), integrated into CI/CD
Comfortable in cross-layer architectural discussions — trade-offs between frontend, API, and backend
 AI & Engineering Productivity
Experience using AI tools to improve development workflows
Practical mindset toward improving engineering velocity with AI
 Great to Have
Experience with Snowflake or modern cloud data warehouses
Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Temporal or similar)
Exposure to cloud-native environments (AWS/Azure) and Kubernetes
Experience mentoring engineers and influencing architectural direction

 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences.
